test_name: DWM-01-HEAD to externally powered ICM-20948 WHO_AM_I check

power_contract.source: DWM3001CDK J2 jumper metal test point
power_contract.ground: J10 pin 6 / black micro test hook
power_contract.warning: J10 pins 2 and 4 are VRPI inputs and must not be used as sensor power outputs

i2c_contract.sda: J10 pin 3 / nRF P0.26 / blue micro test hook
i2c_contract.scl: J10 pin 5 / nRF P0.23 / yellow micro test hook

conclusion: The ICM-20948 is healthy and communicates with DWM-01-HEAD at address 0x69 when supplied from the 3.3 V J2 rail. The earlier failure was caused by attempting to draw sensor power from the input-only J10 VRPI pins and, on the successful-test setup, an initially misplaced SCL hook on J10 pin 4 instead of pin 5.
